title: Your agreements
empty: No agreements have been shared through Studio yet.
notice: Agreement drafting and staff review happen in Control Center. Drafts are not signed agreements and do not grant earnings, verification or a partnership.

steps.title: Review
steps.description: Read the exact version shared with you and raise any questions before signing.

steps.title: Confirm
steps.description: An internal signing experience is being prepared. Production signing requires a fixed document version, authenticated signer, explicit consent and server-recorded evidence.

steps.title: Keep a copy
steps.description: A completed agreement and its evidence must be verified before it is listed as signed. The preview below does not create an agreement.

preview.title: Artist agreement experience
preview.notice: NON-BINDING PREVIEW — no contract, signature, agreement or financial permission is created. Nothing entered here is sent to a server.

sections.title: Parties
sections.text: The artist and legal contracting entity will be identified in an issued agreement. No parties are appointed in this preview.

sections.title: Scope and services
sections.text: Services, rights, territory and term require an approved document. These placeholders are not commercial terms.

sections.title: Reporting and payments
sections.text: Shares, deductions, tax responsibilities and payout conditions require separate approval. No percentage or withdrawal minimum is established here.
